about: Every part in the kit, by folder name. Each folder holds part.json (its description) and the module it names. A preset is a part under another name with some of its defaults changed; a lesson uses it exactly like a part, and can still set anything the part has. `scene` describes what a scene can do besides its parts' calls: its shots and its sound effects.

globe.title: Globe
globe.about: The map as a globe, the way stage 1 had it: projection globe, and no zooming by finger, so two quick taps on a pin step stay two taps. Every setting, call, event and state of the map works on it.

scene.about: A scene with two or more parts directs them with shots (and any scene can lay a title over its picture), called as "shot.<call>" like any action (js/shots.js). It opens on its first part, full, unless its "shot" says otherwise (a shot call without the prefix: ["split", "globe", "section"]). Any action can make a sound effect as it happens ("sound"), and a shot makes its own unless told ("sound": "none").

cut.about: Shows one part, full, and nothing else. how: cut (at once, settling in from a touch closer; a soft puff), fade (one dissolving into the other), push (in from the right; a whoosh), back (in from the left; a whoosh), zoom (the old one swells away, the new one grows into place; a whoosh), through (into a closer view: the open lens grows until it fills the picture while the old view swells past; with no lens, from a small circle in the middle; a whoosh), out (back out: the picture shrinks into a circle, where it went in, and the wider view settles in behind it; a whoosh). Moves run on the measured in-out cubic. cut unless told.

lens.about: A closer look, opened over the picture (a callout): a dot pops at x, y (shares of the picture across and down), a leader line draws itself up from it, and a circle opens at its end onto the part, a closer view of that spot (about a second in all), and holds. Then cut to that part "through" to zoom in through the circle, or "none" shuts it. A soft pop as the circle opens.

split.about: Two parts, one above the other, each half the picture: the same thing seen two ways (from above and from the side), or two places side by side. Parts already showing glide to their halves. A whoosh.

inset.about: Lays a part over a corner of the picture as a small rounded window (top-right unless told): where we are, while the picture is a close-up. "none" takes the inset away. A soft pop.

title.about: A title card: a few big words over the top of the picture (a key term, a number, a span of dates) that stay while the line needs them, fading in and out; a new one replaces the last, and "none" takes it away. It works with one part too. No sound unless told.

sounds.whoosh: A soft rush of air, rising and falling: a push or a zoom to another picture.
sounds.cut: A short soft puff: a cut.
sounds.swell: A warm rising swell: something growing, a storm strengthening.
sounds.pop: A small round bubble: a point or a name arriving.
sounds.chime: Two soft mallet notes: a term worth remembering.
sounds.wind: A breath of wind that builds and dies away: air rushing in, winds blowing.
sounds.rumble: A soft, far-off rumble: a storm cloud.
